page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance designed for parallel, processor-heavy enterprise workloads. Running on the x86_64 architecture under a KVM hypervisor, the instance provides 64 dedicated vCPUs backed by AMD EPYC 7T83 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. Memory capacity is provisioned at 128.0 GB, yielding a compute-centric 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB allocated per core. The instance does not feature discrete GPU accelerators.

Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, supporting robust data transfer across multi-node clusters. The instance provides no bundled local storage, requiring persistent data and operating environments to reside entirely on attached cloud block storage. This architecture decouples processing capacity from storage scaling, though disk-bound workloads must account for network volume latency rather than native NVMe throughput.

From an infrastructure efficiency perspective, the high core density paired with a lean memory footprint maximizes compute resource utilization without the overhead of unused memory capacity. The server fits workloads requiring intensive parallel processing, such as multi-threaded software build pipelines, batch data processing, distributed compute jobs, video transcoding, and high-concurrency web serving tiers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance designed for processor-heavy, multi-threaded enterprise operations. Operating on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture, the instance supplies 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 7T83 processors clocked at 2.55 GHz, paired with 128.0 GB of RAM. This configuration enforces a tight 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, allocating 2.0 GB per vCPU. The server has no bundled local storage or discrete GPU hardware, routing all persistent storage operations through attached block storage volumes. System communication is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. By prioritizing core density over expansive memory capacity, the instance delivers high resource efficiency for stateless compute demands. The ecs.c7a-nps1.16xlarge is appropriate for workloads such as CI/CD compilation clusters, batch processing, video encoding, and high-concurrency application servers.
